answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in copper, verified in terrace, and kernel names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 28 submissions per epoch. A 183 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
